So, built-in specification directives cannot be accidentally removed.\\n- This brings runtime behavior in line with newer GraphQL spec recommendations.\\n\\n#### 4. **Deprecated Directives and Required Reason**\\n- The **reason argument** on `@deprecated` is still *optional*, but now the validation more closely follows the spec (defaulting to `\\\"No longer supported\\\"` if not provided).\\n- There’s no strict enforcement to require a reason (so you don’t have to supply it), but internal tools and best practice recommend you always give one.\\n\\n#### 5. **Deprecation and Validation**\\n- The code-built schemas now enforce the same `deprecated-on-non-null field` validation as SDL-based schemas. This means that if you have fields marked non-null and deprecated in built code, validation will now be stricter, and schemas relying on the old behavior may now fail to validate【3:1†source】.\\n\\n---\\n\\n### References\\n\\n- [GraphQL Java Built-in Directives Documentation (Deep Dive)](https://deepwiki.com/graphql-java/graphql-java/Directives)【3:6†source】\\n- [GraphQL Java Release Notes and Upgrade Guide](https://github.com/graphql-java/graphql-java/releases)【3:1†source】【3:2†source】\\n- [GraphQL Specification on Directives](https://spec.graphql.org/October2021/#sec-Type-System.Directives)【3:9†source】\\n\\n---\\n\\n**Summary Table: What Changed?**\\n\\n| Area           | Pre-23.0 Behavior           | 23.0 Behavior                   |\\n|----------------|----------------------------|---------------------------------|\\n| Built-in Directives | Looser validation        | Strict spec adherence           |\\n| `@deprecated` `reason` | Optional, sometimes inconsistently checked | Optional, stricter spec validation (default applied) |\\n| RuntimeWiring  | Register as usual          | API unchanged, but now more robust for spec directives |\\n| Clearing Directives | User could remove all directives | Spec directives always re-added |\\n| Schema Validation | Some mismatches allowed | Strict deprecation \\u0026 nullability validation |\\n\\nIf you want code samples or deep dives into a specific topic (like `SchemaDirectiveWiring` usage or migration hints), let me know!\",\n    \"annotations\": [\n      {\n        \"text\": \"\",\n        \"start_index\": 885,\n        \"end_index\": 897,\n        \"url_citation\": {\n          \"title\": \"Directives | graphql-java/graphql-java | DeepWiki\",\n          \"url\": \"https://deepwiki.com/graphql-java/graphql-java/7.2-directives\"\n        }\n      },\n      {\n        \"text\": \"\",\n        \"start_index\": 897,\n        \"end_index\": 909,\n        \"url_citation\": {\n          \"title\": \"Directives -
